headline: Tesla begins first public-road engineering tests of production Cybercab WITHOUT steering wheel, pedals, or any human controls in Austin — @Tesla official X account posted video of unit navigating Austin traffic autonomously; safety monitor in passenger seat only during testing phase; hundreds of Cybercabs simultaneously shipping to Dallas and Houston hubs; Tesla VP Lars Moravy teases 'big announcement' at Giga Texas July 7 with sources pointing to Cybercab production scaling or mid-July Houston commercial launch (@Tesla on X / notateslaapp / basenor, Jun 30, 2026)

Texas regulatory stack for Cybercab commercial deployment now essentially complete — Tesla self-certified commercial robotaxi software as SAE Level 4 under Texas state law (May 28); Cybercab officially listed in Texas DPS Connected AV First Responder Interaction Plan registry; official Cybercab emergency handbook classifies it as 'completely driverless' with SAE Level 4 Autonomous Mode; combined with NHTSA brake pedal removal (Jun 24) and statewide TX AV Registry entry, Tesla has cleared all major regulatory gates for large-scale Cybercab commercial service in Texas (notateslaapp / basenor / Texas DPS, Jun 29-30, 2026)

Deutsche Bank raises Tesla Q2 delivery estimate to ~416,000 — joins Goldman Sachs (420K), JPMorgan (420K), Barclays (~418K), Morgan Stanley (413K) all above Tesla IR consensus of 406,024; Bloomberg consensus at ~396,466 (20 analysts); Q2 report due July 2; Europe + international sales are the primary upside driver; a print above 413K would mark Tesla's first clear YoY delivery acceleration since 2023 (Deutsche Bank / Bloomberg / Yahoo Finance, Jun 30, 2026)

Tesla crashes into Urbane Café patio in Simi Valley, CA — 1 killed, 5 injured; driver (64-year-old woman) failed to make turn through parking lot; 4 juvenile passengers in white Tesla; FSD status under investigation (no autonomous mode confirmed); third high-profile Tesla crash in 3 weeks following Texas fatal (Jun 20, FSD active) and Arizona settlement (Jun 26); NHTSA EA26002 (3.2M-vehicle reduced-visibility FSD probe) remains active — accelerating regulatory scrutiny on the brand ahead of Q2 delivery report (ABC7 / NBC LA / Simi Valley PD, Jun 30, 2026)
source: ABC7 / NBC LA / Simi Valley PD

headline: Cantor Fitzgerald warns Q2 delivery miss — projects 397,414 deliveries vs 408,609 consensus; still bullish long-term: 'AI, robotics, and chips could drive transformational 2026'; contrasts with Morgan Stanley (413K) and Barclays (418K) bull estimates; Q2 delivery report due July 2; wide analyst divergence signals maximum uncertainty into the print — a beat could re-accelerate; a miss with inventory build would renew structural demand concerns (Cantor Fitzgerald / Yahoo Finance, Jun 30, 2026)

FSD v14 Lite HW3 first impressions overwhelmingly positive — early access users reporting zero interventions on complex routes (Culver City to Hollywood); Electrek confirms RL improvements, parking/unparking, pedestrian interactions, and navigation handling all translate well via model distillation from HW4; 'distilled the intelligence from HW4 V14 into HW3' per release notes; 2026.20.5.1 release notes also add Robotaxi-style drop-off arrival options; broader rollout to more HW3 customers over coming weeks pending validation (notateslaapp / Electrek / basenor, Jun 29, 2026)

TSLA +8.5% closes $401.84 to lead Magnificent Seven as Morgan Stanley, Barclays raise Q2 delivery estimates above consensus — Morgan Stanley upgraded Q2 forecast from 373K to 413K citing European + China demand recovery; Barclays projected ~418K; both above prior consensus of 406K; Q2 delivery report confirmed for July 2; Nasdaq +2.1%, S&P 500 +1.2%, Dow closes above 52,000 for first time (Morgan Stanley / Barclays / GuruFocus / Investopedia, Jun 29, 2026)

Tesla quietly settles FSD pedestrian death lawsuit as NHTSA 3.2M-vehicle Engineering Analysis remains active — Tesla settled wrongful death suit over Nov 2023 Arizona crash (71-year-old pedestrian struck by Model Y in FSD mode); separately, June 20 fatal Texas crash (Model 3 through Houston-area home wall, victim 76-year-old Martha Avila) opens new federal probe; NHTSA EA26002 is the final step before agency can force a recall; Tesla admits FSD was active in Texas crash, blames driver override (Electrek / Autoblog / The Verge, Jun 26, 2026)

NHTSA removes mandatory brake pedal requirement for fully autonomous vehicles — FMVSS 135 updated to allow ADS-exclusive cabins without manual brake controls; alternative stopping-distance testing still required; NHTSA Administrator Morrison: 'tearing down pointless barriers to innovative designs while strengthening fundamental safety requirements'; direct regulatory unlock for Cybercab's pedal-free, steering-wheel-free design; largest federal AV equipment rule reform in decades (NHTSA press release, Jun 24, 2026)

Tesla, Sunrun, and Renew Home announce 16 GW virtual power plant — largest distributed power plant in US history; aggregates Powerwall home batteries, smart thermostats, and connected devices targeting hyperscalers and data center operators; 300+ MW immediately deployable, scaling to 500+ MW by 2030; confirms Powerwall fleet as commercial-grade VPP backbone capable of enterprise-scale energy delivery; first concrete proof-point of Tesla's VPP as a revenue-generating grid asset beyond residential programs (Electrek / Globe Newswire, Jun 24, 2026)
